additional_info.body:
Hi Jose,
I managed to get the logs for March 5th until 10 PM UTC. SCB only allows me to download logs in 2-hour timestamp intervals, so there will be multiple log files for this period.
Regarding the wake-up function and preconditioning function, we are handing over this ticket to Expert Service. There is a workaround for the wake-up function, and for the preconditioning function, they will let you know if we have a solution on our charger side.
Thank you.
